May’22 TTS monthly (UTen; Indonesia). Live GMV $64.78M (¥428M) vs Apr $67.60M; orders 19.73M; creators 78k; streams 1.652M; ASP/stream $38.7. Labor Day + Ramadan spike (May 5 GMV $246k, ASP/stream $97.7) then mid-month cool. Top SKUs ASP <$30 beauty/personal care (e.g. Bioaqua sheet mask $7.5). Top creator Margareta; peak day GMV $17k / 3,137 orders. Full category/SKU/creator/shop tables in CN images — attach on ingest.
